_doc: Optional painted pieces for Choose your path and the class guide (scripts/ui/deck_select.gd, scripts/ui/class_info_panel.gd). The screens look finished without them: each one replaces a piece built from existing art (noted in 'replaces'). One take each, no text in the image. Install as assets/ui/<id>.png (alpha) and wire it where 'replaces' says.
style: hand-tinted 19th century wood engraving in the style of Gustave Dore, dense fine crosshatching, aged bronze and dark iron, glowing ember orange and deep crimson highlights, game UI asset, centered, no text, no letters, no symbols

assets.unused: 2026-10-27: painted, compared on Choose your path and not installed: in the deck cell its narrow window shrinks the face art to a sliver and the name plaque hides the box's foot; the carved card border reads better. The original is kept in art_src/ui/pieces/.
assets.replaces: the stacked card borders of a deck in the library (_stack_card / _border): the face art shows through the open window
assets.prompt: Front view of an ornate closed deck box for playing cards, slightly turned so its right side and the gilded page edges of the stacked cards inside show, heavy aged bronze frame with riveted corners and scrollwork, the large rectangular front window left completely empty and transparent, dark iron sides, isolated on a transparent background

assets.replaces: the STARTER corner tag (_tag): the word stays set in code on it
assets.prompt: A small horizontal brass label plate with a gold rim and a smooth blank centre, two tiny rivets at the ends, warm polished gold, isolated on a transparent background
